stem.text: A piece of rock has a mass of $2.00\,\text{g}$. It contains calcium carbonate, but no other basic substances. It neutralises exactly $36.0\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $0.500\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ hydrochloric acid.
What is the percentage by mass of calcium carbonate in the $2.00\,\text{g}$ piece of rock?
